input.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/dates.ts

The issue is caused by the `startOfWeek` function in `src/util/dates.ts` ignoring the provided time zone parameter (`tz`). It calculates the start of the week using UTC instead of the user's local time zone, leading to incorrect week boundaries for users in different time zones (e.g., Sydney vs. London). This explains why the Monday summary email arrives on Tuesday for users in Sydney.

The fix requires updating `startOfWeek` to use the time zone for determining the start of the week.
